data.summary: E082 experiment: view-count principle on medical device alarm codes. Key results: G1 PASS (30≥30 both arms), G2 FAIL (0.60 accuracy vs 0.85 threshold, rubric/seed misalignment), G3 REPORTING: treatment 56.7% served (17/30), 1% partially_served (1/30), 43.3% unserved (12/30); control 60.0% served (18/30), 30.0% partially_served (9/30), 10.0% unserved (3/30). Key differentiator: medical devices also show 0% partially_served pattern like lab instruments (vs 31.4% in general computer errors), confirming even more binary served/unserved distribution. G4 FAIL (12/20 top-arrival vs threshold 17/20). Decision: hold - principle generalizes to medical domain but with consistent binary pattern; next priority domain needed per D083.
